datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Zambia in 2013, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases under different scenarios. The spatial data represents post-assessment impact classifications of food insecurity severity, which is a loss indicator driven by underlying hazards such as drought.
